rule_or_pattern: Drop every line flagged D:column_crossing_line (width > 0.8 of text width on this two-column page), not only the column_merge_line subset; keep the single-column lines.
notes: One-page 1865 parliament minutes, two columns; about half the admitted lines are crops spanning both columns across the gutter (1, 12, 16-40). Most of those labels faithfully join two half-lines, but some do not match the crop at all (22, 23, 30 give only a fragment from the other column), and several are flagged only as crossing, not merge (1, 16-20), so the merge-only pool rule would miss them. The single-column lines (2-11, 14, 15) read correctly with accents intact.
